Human fixture (default):
  Study: SRP568085 (Ewing sarcoma SLAM-seq)
  Sample: GSM8829548 (A2.2_150nM_SLAM-seq_rep2)
  Accession: SRR32576116 (SE150)

Commands used:
  fastq-dump -X 100000 --gzip -O test/tmp_slam_fixture SRR32576116
  zcat test/tmp_slam_fixture/SRR32576116.fastq.gz | head -n 400000 | gzip > \
    test/fixtures/slam/raw/slam_100000_reads_SRR32576116.fastq.gz

Reference (standard 110-44):
  Genome: /storage/autoindex_110_44/bulk_index/cellranger_ref/genome.fa
  GTF:    /storage/autoindex_110_44/bulk_index/cellranger_ref/genes.gtf
  STAR index: /storage/autoindex_110_44/bulk_index

Fixture notes:
  Read length: 150
  Read count: 100000
  Default SNP handling: prefilter BAM by removing reads that overlap GRAND-SLAM
    detected SNPs (snpdata -> BED -> samtools view -L -U). The final reference
    outputs are generated from the prefiltered BAM.
  Optional: an external SNP VCF can be converted to BED and used for the same
    prefilter step (ensure contig naming matches the BAM).
  Reference output: test/fixtures/slam/expected/fixture_ref_human.tsv.gz
  SNP BED (data-derived): test/fixtures/slam/ref/snps.bed

IMPORTANT: The original fixture was generated from the PREFILTERED (noSNP) BAM,
  NOT the full BAM. Using the full BAM gives ~0.99 correlation due to extra
  reads at SNP positions. To exactly reproduce the fixture:
  - Use fixture_human_Aligned.sortedByCoord.noSNP.bam (NOT the full BAM)
  - Use -err 0.001 -strandness AutoDetect with GEDI

STAR alignment parameters:
  --outSAMattributes NH HI AS nM MD
  --clip3pAdapterSeq AGATCGGAAGAG
  --clip3pAdapterMMp 0.1

GRAND-SLAM parameters:
  -strandness Sense
  -snpConv 0.3
  -snppval 0.001
  -full (for quantification)
  -err 0.001 (CRITICAL: explicit error rate for reproducibility)

Regeneration script:
  bash tests/regenerate_slam_fixture.sh
  See also: test/fixtures/slam/meta/REGENERATION_NOTES.md

Mouse fixture (legacy):
  Zenodo record: 7612564 (Herzog et al., 2017), QuantSeq 3' mRNA-Seq, SE50.
  Accession: SRR5678872 (mESC.0h.chase.A)
  File: test/fixtures/slam/raw/slam_100000_reads.fastq.gz
